name: V25
description: Two-stage bone tumor screener: EfficientNet-B3 gate (300px) + EfficientNet-B6 specialist (456px), fine-tuned on the entity families the error anatomy flagged (ABC, bone island, chondroblastoma, CMF, BFH, chondrosarcoma, adamantinoma, chordoma, angiosarcoma, GCT, fibrous dysplasia, metastases) plus 38 harvested radiographs of the same diagnoses.

wild.note: 180 real-world radiographs (Radiology Assistant + bonetumor.org), LEAK-FREE: 19 of the 199 collected films were byte-identical to images in the training set (8 of them inside the 78-film held-out slice) and were removed. Measured at the shipped gate 0.3 / malignant 0.3. On the un-cleaned 199-film board the same model scored 143/199 with 80/95 cancers; that number was inflated by the duplicates and is not quoted.

independent.note: 50 radiographs from Wikimedia Commons, a THIRD source unseen by any model; V21 scored 11/50. 46 benign / 4 malignant, so it tests generalisation, not cancer recall.

selection_rule: malignant recall >= 80% of the wild cancers, then max combined correct across the 564 benchmark + leak-free wild pool + 50 third-source films

measured_contenders.V25: leak-free wild 133/180 (at its own best threshold) / 131/180 at the shipped thresholds
